name: SUPER MYSTERIOUS HOSPITAL MYSTERY!
source:
You awake in a mysterious hospital with many mysterious injuries... You are also dead! But this is the afterlife... So it doesn't matter!

Choose from one of 5 doctors at this mysterious hospital, to help you with your super mysterious hospital mystery! ( And your injuries ).
